ops.quote: We propose a metric learning formulation called Weighted Approximate Rank Component Analysis (WARCA).
Using this new regularizer allows us to adapt the large-scale WSABIE procedure
and to leverage the Adam stochastic optimization algorithm
which results in an algorithm that scales gracefully to very large data-sets
WARCA optimizes the precision at top ranks by combining the WARP loss with a regularizer
we derive a kernelized version which allows to take advantage of state-of-the-art features
when data-set size permits kernel computation
Benchmarks on recent and standard re-identification data-sets show that our method beats existing state-of-the-art techniques
